conflictKind.CONCURRENT_EDIT: Changed on this device and on another device
conflictKind.SERVER_CONFLICT: The server already holds a newer version
conflictKind.STALE_INBOUND: The server sent an older version than the one here
conflictKind.EQUAL_VERSION_DIVERGENCE: Same version number with different content
conflictKind.CODE_CLASH: The same number is used here by another record
conflictKind.GRANT_BY_UNAUTHORISED_ADMIN: Right granted by someone who no longer holds it
conflictKind.USERNAME_CLASH: The same username was created on two PCs
conflictKind.MATERIALIZE_ERROR: A received change could not be applied
conflictKind.OUTBOX_DEAD_LETTER: A local change could not be sent after repeated attempts
conflictKind.AUTHORITY_MISMATCH: The server refused a protected change
conflictKind.APPEND_ONLY_DELETE: History cannot be deleted by synchronisation
conflictKind.AUDIT_STUB_REFUSED: An audit trail link received from another PC was refused (for this PC's own trail, or malformed)
conflictKind.INVALID_VALUE: A received change holds a value this version does not accept
conflictKind.SETTING_LOCKED: A setting that can no longer change here (postings depend on it)
conflictKind.WEEK_LIFECYCLE_BACKWARDS: A planning week would go back in its lifecycle
conflictKind.PLANNING_WEEK_FROZEN: Work enters a week frozen here without a valid signed break-in (change time on the other PC and freeze time here below). Keep this PC's plan; a legitimate change is redone here with a fresh signed break-in. The conflict closes by itself if its signed break-in arrives
conflictKind.PLANNING_BREAK_IN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: An urgent break-in, or one forcing a blocking check, received without an approver. Keep this PC's plan; a legitimate change is redone here with a fresh signed break-in
conflictKind.PLANNING_BREAK_IN_SELF_APPROVAL: A break-in approved by the person who asked for it (four-eyes). Keep this PC's plan; a legitimate change is redone here with a fresh signed break-in
conflictKind.PLANNING_BREAK_IN_APPROVER_UNAUTHORISED: A break-in approved by someone without plan.confirm at the crew's site here. Keep this PC's plan; a legitimate change is redone here with a fresh signed break-in
conflictKind.PLANNING_BREAK_IN_UNSIGNED: A break-in whose approver did not sign with their password (older version). Keep this PC's plan; a legitimate change is redone here with a fresh signed break-in
conflictKind.WEEK_UNFREEZE_UNDECIDED: A week unfrozen without its unfreeze decision. The conflict closes by itself if the decision arrives; otherwise keep this PC's plan (the week stays frozen)
conflictKind.WEEK_UNFREEZE_SAME_PERSON: A week unfrozen by a decision of the person who asked for it (four-eyes). Keep this PC's plan: the week stays frozen
conflictKind.WEEK_UNFREEZE_UNAUTHORISED: A week unfrozen by someone without plan.confirm at the site here. Keep this PC's plan: the week stays frozen
conflictKind.DECISION_SELF_APPROVAL: A decision approved by the person who proposed it (four-eyes)
conflictKind.DECISION_STATUS_REGRESSION: A received reliability decision would go backwards (applied → approved, approved → proposed, or a refusal cleared). Keep this PC's decision: it is then refused on every PC
conflictKind.DECISION_CONTENT_CHANGED: A received reliability decision whose content changed after it was proposed, or no longer matches its approval seal. Keep this PC's decision: it is then refused on every PC; a legitimate decision is proposed and approved again
conflictKind.DECISION_APPROVAL_UNSEALED: A reliability decision approved without an approval seal by a version that seals. Keep this PC's decision: it is then refused on every PC
conflictKind.DECISION_NOT_DESIGNATED_APPROVER: A reliability decision approved by someone other than its designated approver. Keep this PC's decision: it is then refused on every PC
conflictKind.DECISION_APPROVER_UNAUTHORISED: A reliability decision approved by someone without the right to approve (ram.manage, plant-wide) here. The conflict closes by itself if the right arrives; otherwise keep this PC's decision
conflictKind.DECISION_APPLIER_UNAUTHORISED: A reliability decision applied by someone without the rights to apply it (ram.manage and pm.edit or ot.create) here. The conflict closes by itself if the rights arrive; otherwise keep this PC's decision
conflictKind.WO_PART_LINE_HAS_USE: A planned part line was cancelled on another device, but parts were already used or issued from the store for it here: check the line with the planner and the store before deciding
conflictKind.SITE_SETTING_UNAUDITED: A site rule changed without its audited change (step-up, reason, settings right)
conflictKind.SITE_SETTING_INVALID: A site rule with an unreadable value or time
conflictKind.SITE_SETTING_EVENT_INVALID: An incomplete or future-dated change of a site rule
conflictKind.SITE_SETTING_NOT_A_SITE: A site rule set on something that is not a site
conflictKind.SITE_SETTING_STALE: An older change of a site rule after a later one
conflictKind.SITE_SETTING_UNKNOWN: A site rule this version does not know
conflictKind.SITE_SETTING_MOVED: A site rule moved to a site that does not replace its deleted site
conflictKind.SYNC_STATE_TIME_MISSING: A status received without the time it requires (activation, start)
conflictKind.PERMIT_STATUS_BACKWARDS: A finished permit would go back in its lifecycle
conflictKind.PERMIT_EXPIRY_MISSING: A permit activated without an expiry
conflictKind.PERMIT_EXPIRED: A permit used after its expiry
conflictKind.PERMIT_EXPIRES_BEFORE_PLANNED_END: A work order started on a permit that expires before its planned end
conflictKind.PERMIT_EXPIRES_BEFORE_ESTIMATED_END: A work order started or resumed on a permit that expires before its start or resume plus its expected duration (or the remaining time entered)
conflictKind.WO_PLANNED_END_PASSED: A work order started or resumed on a permit after its planned end had passed, with no usable expected duration or remaining time (re-plan its dates)
conflictKind.WO_EXPECTED_DURATION_UNREADABLE: A work order started on a permit with an expected duration that is not a number of hours
conflictKind.WO_REMAINING_TIME_INVALID: A work order resumed or reopened with an estimated remaining time that is not a number of hours greater than 0
conflictKind.WO_PLANNED_END_UNREADABLE: A work order started with a planned end that is not a readable date and time (re-plan its dates)
conflictKind.LOTO_NO_ISOLATION: A LOTO permit activated without any isolation point
conflictKind.LOTO_NOT_VERIFIED: A permit activated with isolations not verified by a second person
conflictKind.LOTO_ISOLATION_REMOVED: A permit activated with a lock already removed
conflictKind.PERMIT_REMOVAL_PENDING: A permit closed with locks still in place
conflictKind.PERMIT_HANDOVER_REQUIRED: A permit handed back without a valid handover log
conflictKind.PERMIT_SUSPENSION_MISSING: A permit suspended without a recorded suspension
conflictKind.PERMIT_ISOLATION_NOT_APPLIED: An isolation verified before it was applied
conflictKind.PERMIT_TWO_PERSON_VERIFY: An isolation verified by the person who applied it (two-person rule)
conflictKind.PERMIT_REMOVAL_NOT_VERIFIABLE: A lock removal verified on an isolation never verified
conflictKind.PERMIT_TWO_PERSON_REMOVAL: A lock removal verified by the person who applied it (two-person rule)
conflictKind.PERMIT_REQUIRED_TO_START: A work order started without the work permit it requires
conflictKind.PERMIT_SUSPENDED: A work order started while its permit was suspended
conflictKind.PERMIT_NOT_ACTIVE: A work order started while its permit was not active
conflictKind.QUALIFICATION_OVERRIDE_REASON_SHORT: A qualification override without a sufficient reason
conflictKind.QUALIFICATION_OVERRIDE_INVALID: An incomplete qualification override (person, context or approver)
conflictKind.QUALIFICATION_OVERRIDE_SELF: A qualification override approved by the person it concerns
conflictKind.QUALIFICATION_OVERRIDE_UNAUTHORISED: A qualification override approved by someone without the certification right here
conflictKind.PERMIT_ISOLATION_MOVED: An isolation moved to another permit
conflictKind.PERMIT_ISOLATION_WRONG_STATUS: An isolation changed while its permit did not allow it
conflictKind.PERMIT_ISOLATION_CANCELLED: An isolation line cancelled here was changed, applied or restored on another PC
conflictKind.PERMIT_ISOLATION_CANCEL_APPLIED: An isolation line cancelled on another PC although it was applied (here or there)
conflictKind.PERMIT_ISOLATION_CANCEL_WRONG_STATUS: An isolation line cancelled on another PC while its permit is no longer a draft or waiting for review here
conflictKind.PERMIT_ISOLATION_CANCEL_INVALID: An isolation line cancelled without a readable author or time
conflictKind.PERMIT_DELETE_REFUSED: A permit, isolation or suspension still protecting work was deleted elsewhere

conflictKind.WO_TOOL_AFTER_CLOSE: Tool changed on another PC while the work order is closed here

conflictKind.PERMIT_FORCED_REMOVAL_AUTHORISER_IS_REMO: A forced lock removal authorised by the person who took the lock off
conflictKind.PERMIT_FORCED_REMOVAL_REMOVER_IS_APPLIER: A forced lock removal whose remover is the absent worker
conflictKind.PERMIT_FORCED_REMOVAL_UNAUTHORISED: A forced lock removal authorised by someone without the permit close right at the permit's site on this PC

conflictKind.PERMIT_HANDOVER_RECEIVER_IS_SIGNER: A permit hand-over received by the person who signed it

conflictKind.PERMIT_TYPE_THREE_PERSON_UNAUDITED: A permit type's third-person lock-removal rule changed on another PC without who, when or why

conflictKind.PERMIT_EQUIPMENT_LOCKED: The equipment or work order of a permit approved here was changed on another PC
conflictKind.PERMIT_SITE_LOCKED: The site of a permit approved here was changed on another PC

conflictKind.PERMIT_WO_UNLINKED: A permit's work order was removed from it on another PC

conflictKind.PERMIT_TYPE_LOTO_ISOLATION_LOCKED: The LOTO permit type's energy-isolation rule switched off on another PC
conflictKind.PERMIT_TYPE_CODE_LOCKED: A permit type's code changed on another PC

conflictKind.NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY_LOCKED: A change from another PC that would switch off or re-route the notice of a safety rule changed on another PC
conflictKind.LAST_ADMINISTRATOR_REQUIRED: A change from another PC that would leave this PC without an active administrator

conflictKind.ADMIN_RECOVERY_ACK_CHANGED: An acknowledgement of a recovery-code notice was changed on another PC: acknowledgements are never changed

conflictKind.SITE_ASSIGNMENT_NODE_INVALID: A site given on another PC to a record without one, on a unit deleted here
conflictKind.SITE_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_ALLOWED: A site given on another PC to a record without one, by someone without the organisation administration right for the whole plant
conflictKind.SITE_SET_WITHOUT_ASSIGNMENT: A work order or request without a site received with a site, without the site assignment of an organisation administrator

progress.keepOpen: Keep the computer on until Maintafox has restarted.

lock.title: Maintafox is installing an update
lock.body: Your data is being backed up and the update installed. Nothing can be changed until Maintafox has restarted. Do not turn off the computer.

refusal.update_withdrawn: This update is no longer offered as you confirmed it (it may have been paused, withdrawn or replaced). Nothing was changed. Check what is offered now before installing.
refusal.rollback_unsynced_changes_one: {{count}} change is not synchronised yet. Synchronise first, then try again; otherwise it would be lost.
refusal.rollback_unsynced_changes_other: {{count}} changes are not synchronised yet. Synchronise first, then try again; otherwise they would be lost.
refusal.rollback_backup_missing: The backup needed to go back to version {{version}} is not on this computer. Contact Maintafox support.
refusal.rollback_refused: Going back to version {{version}} was refused by the update server. Nothing was changed. Contact Maintafox support.
refusal.rollback_backup_changed: The backup needed to go back to version {{version}} has changed since it was taken (its checksum does not match), so it is not used. Nothing was changed. Contact Maintafox support.
refusal.restore_pending: A restore of the database is waiting for Maintafox to restart. Restart Maintafox first, then install the update. Nothing was changed.

error.install: The update could not be installed. Nothing was changed: Maintafox keeps working on version {{version}}. Check the internet connection and try again, or contact Maintafox support.
error.check: The update check could not run. Maintafox keeps working; it will try again later.
error.adminRequired: Only an administrator of this computer can install updates. Ask an administrator to sign in and install it.
error.signInRequired: Sign in as an administrator of this computer to install the update.

notice.rolledBack: The update to version {{to}} could not update your data. Maintafox went back to version {{from}} and restored your data as it was before the update. Changes made after that are downloaded again from the server when you synchronise.
notice.installNotCompleted: The update to {{to}} did not complete. You are still on {{from}}; nothing was changed.

status.title: Updates
status.available: Version {{version}} is available. Install it from the message at the top of the window.
status.not_configured: In-app updates are not set up in this build yet.
status.not_activated: Updates are available once this computer is activated.
status.unreachable: The update server could not be reached. Maintafox keeps working; it will try again later.

recovery.title: The update could not be completed
recovery.body: Version {{to}} could not update your data. Your data is safe: the backup made just before the update will be put back automatically.
recovery.unavailable: The previous version cannot be downloaded right now. Check the internet connection and try again, or contact Maintafox support.
recovery.error: Version {{from}} could not be reinstalled. Check the internet connection and try again, or contact Maintafox support.
recovery.refused: The update server refused to reinstall version {{from}}. Keep this computer as it is: do not reinstall, reset or replace Maintafox. Your data is safe in the backup made before the update. Contact Maintafox support.
recovery.allowedVersion: For information: the update server names version {{version}} as allowed instead. It is not installed automatically; Maintafox support decides.
recovery.bodyBackupUnverified: Version {{to}} could not update your data, and the backup made just before the update could not be verified, so it was not put back.
recovery.backupUnverified: Keep this computer as it is: do not reinstall, reset or replace Maintafox, and do not reinstall version {{from}} (it could not open the data). Contact Maintafox support.

mandatoryReason.forced_update_floor: Your organisation requires this version or a newer one.
mandatoryReason.rollback_requested: This computer goes back to the version it ran before the failed update.
mandatoryReason.recalled_version: The version installed here was withdrawn by Maintafox.

forced.adminHint: An administrator of this computer installs the update: sign in as an administrator, then install it here. After the restart, check the licence again.
